gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-atkinson-hyper: Precise and modern, Blockletter draws every stroke with zero modulation, while Atkinson Hyperlegible sits beneath it with a gentle, barely-there variation. The standout trait is the body's wide-set s terminals against that uniform heading.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-carrois-gothic: A ruler-drawn, constant-width line defines Blockletter, while Carrois Gothic SC brings a slight stroke variation and curves that stay open. Capitals nearly match lowercase height, which quietly steadies the pairing.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-comme: Blockletter's tall, squat-bellied midsection looks brush-drawn, though its lines never thicken on the downstrokes, and Comme keeps its lowercase bodies large. Smooth curves in the body let the heading's pencil line stand alone.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-cossette-texte: Blockletter has a tall, squat midsection and pencil-light lines of constant pressure. Cossette Texte brings a prominent x-height plus wide-eyed lowercase e, so let the heading go larger to hold its own.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-funnel-sans: Blockletter has a tall, squat midsection and pencil lines that never press harder, so it earns its keep big and short. Funnel Sans keeps stroke widths steady with a lowercase e that opens like a clasp.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-heebo: Precise and modern, Blockletter has slim, pipe-cleaner joins throughout. It does its best work as display lettering, while Heebo gives text a tall central band and curves that stop short.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-inter-tight: Squat belly, steady pencil line: Blockletter leads, then Inter Tight follows with tubing-like curves and ascenders that barely rise. Pages of text would move briskly, with curve tails held well back.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-khula: Open-mouthed curves let the body read smoothly, and its tall midsection echoes the squat belly of Blockletter. Khula carries the eye along with its slight stroke shading, which the heading's uniform line lacks.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend: A tall, squat-bellied midsection marks Blockletter's precise pencil line. Lexend meets it with outsized lowercase, open jaws on every curve, and a thickness that holds steady all around each bend.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-deca: Pencil-light and precise: Blockletter bulges at the middle. Lexend Deca's unshaded line is the standout, with terminals that stop short of curling back and capitals that look small beside the big lowercase.
